title: Build the Celerity vehicle control runtime
wayfinder_map_title: Design the Celerity vehicle control runtime

plan_review.feedback_summary: Exact fingerprint-bound approval received with no annotations, layout warnings, or change requests.
plan_review.approval_validity_rationale: The sole adversarial event clarified accepted safety, Linux validation, timing, CI, and resource-evidence contracts without changing user-approved intent.

dispositions.outcome: Each accepted Command refreshes the independent controller-local Command Lease; a conformance scenario expires it while Runtime Lease remains valid.

vcan proves only zero application transmission and interface separation; live startup verifies a preconfigured real 1 Mbit/s LISTEN-ONLY netdevice with restart-ms 0 before binding, while on-wire silence remains HIL evidence.

Synchronous non-cancellable tract inference uses startup benchmark evidence and a pre-inference remaining-budget gate; surprising overruns are recorded and fail safe without a worker/service redesign.

DiscoveryProbe, NodeAnnounce, and CapabilityReport remain required for statically provisioned controller truth, reboot, generation, and capability reconciliation; discovery grants no authority or dynamic enrolment.

systemd CI is pinned to the standard ubuntu-24.04 VM, verifies exact units, installs temporary units under /run/systemd/system with passwordless sudo, exercises lifecycle behavior, and cleans up from a trap.
Firmware evidence includes a checked G431-specific FDCAN message-RAM allocation for filters, receive/transmit elements, payload sizes, offsets, overlap, and total words before G474 consideration.
Runtime events now carry current monotonic ingest time separately from sensor observation time used for staleness, preventing valid live I/O order from latching a false hard fault.
STM32 firmware selects a fresh nonzero hardware-RNG boot session, rejects the immediately prior TAMP backup-domain value, and establishes safe fallback before waiting for randomness.

Configuration is explicitly volatile; each fresh boot session starts in local fallback and requires discovery plus full configuration reconciliation before leases or commands. Unused flash-persistence code and claims were removed.
Missing, unstaged, incompatible, unreadable, or nonfinite desired baselines fail candidate evaluation closed; only the intentional no-desired-baseline bootstrap case may stage without comparison.

One canonical Run v1 decoder validates protobuf framing, schema major, source and typed-payload cardinality, strict sequence increase, monotonic time, UTF-8, and signal validity at HTTP admission and corpus load.

SQLite uses WAL, a busy timeout, an immediate transaction and a one-active-job unique index; recovery validates PID start time, deterministic duplicate models converge to no-change, and notifications are idempotent.
A direct firmware/emulator equivalence test compares configuration, leases, command acceptance, mode, split, and expiry, while firmware golden conformance re-encodes and byte-compares every vector.
Vehicle bearer tokens are compared with hmac.compare_digest.

planning.execplan_improvement_summary: Grounded Linux CAN timestamps, errors, bus-off, and Haltech decoding in branch evidence; preserved research with supersession; added sync configuration, one normalization path, and sync authority-isolation validation.

implementation.reopen_reason: Closeout review found that celerityd did not execute the runtime lifecycle and the executor could not select a model command.

normal_closeout_review.outcome: Implementation reopened; the production live runtime, model command path, Run lifecycle, and end-to-end evidence were completed and validated before adversarial review.
